a.text: Being upfront: with a 65% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first gives each of us only about a 12% chance of survival. I'm proposing we change it. I intend to take 4 in round 1, so the existing 4 cells save at least one of us for sure. If you also take, the split is random. After that I'll keep operating with you every round to refill the reserve for you. I'll also give cells back if that helps you reach 4. I won't mislead you about my actions.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I'll operate with you every round from now on until you have 4. I'm sorry this departs from the original plan. With the storm odds, it was the only way to guarantee that at least one of us survives.
